game_updates.title: Project UK Rework: New Assets to Build the World With
game_updates.contents: What makes a town or city feel unmistakably British? Is it the familiar rows of brick houses, the traditional pubs on street corners, or the charming shops lining a busy high street? For our UK Rework project in Euro Truck Simulator 2, capturing these familiar sights is an important part of bringing Britain to life. That's why our talented teams have been busy creating hundreds of new assets, and today, we'd like to share a closer look at some of them! As you travel across the UK, you'll notice how the architecture changes from one region to another, with each town and city reflecting its own unique character and history. To help capture that authentic British atmosphere in our rework project, our teams have been hard at work creating hundreds of new assets, over 370 of them, in fact! But ...

game_updates.title: Beta Patch Notes - v0.113.0
game_updates.contents: At long last, the biggest (beta) patch yet is here!!! Reminder that this patch is exclusive to the beta branch of the game as we've got some really impactful bits of content that will require lots of testing before they reach the main branch. Reminder that if you'd like to swap over to the beta branch, you can do so by right-clicking on Slay the Spire 2 in your library and navigating to Properties -> Game Versions & Betas and selecting `public-beta` from the dropdown. The main branch will be brought up-to-date with all content and changes in the previous, more stable beta version, v0.111.0. So don't be confused that the following content isn't there if you boot up the main branch. Without further ado, let's take a look at all the new goodies there are to test out... game_updates.contents: This update fixes Jackbox Megapicker launch issues stemming from an October update to the Steam client. Choosing a game in the Megapicker launches it, instead of getting stuck in a launch loop. Also in this update: • Fixed games launched from the info panel sometimes leaving a black tile behind. • Improved the contrast of the Idol Factions and Fakin' It XL tile logos. • New splash screen art.

game_updates.title: Noble Fates 1.0 is out now!
game_updates.contents: Dear mortals. Dear, dear friends. The day has finally arrived. After almost six years and eight major updates in Early Access, Noble Fates has left Early Access, and 1.0 is out now. To every Noble who played, reported bugs, made mods and argued with us on Discord along the way: thank you. This release is as much yours as it is ours.Since we started working on this game of ours, I estimate I have put in more than 20,000 hours into making it. The game has become part of us, and so have you. But the beginning of the next chapter is something that excites us as much as the first one did. If we were in Noble Fates, we would probably look something like this. Our publishing guy Sterling is the small maniacal manchild in the middle. 1.0 is by far the largest update we have ever made.
